ee:transform.doc:name: Map JSC to OUT (English keys only)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var p = payload var sub = if (sizeOf(p.content default []) > 0) p.content[0] else p var pp = sub.priceplan default {} var bal = if (sub.balance is Object) (sub.balance.amount default sub.balance) else sub.balance --- { code: 200, idSubscription: sub.id, planName: pp.pricePlanName default pp.name default "", status: sub.status, billingType: sub.billingType, balance: bal, externalId: sub.externalID, subscriberId: (sub.subscriber default {}).id default "" }
